$comment: Non-secret, versioned rule configuration (provisional demo values - not Siemens-approved). The API seeds these into rule_settings on first start; edits create new versions (rule_editing permission). Python evaluates the active version effective at the evaluation sim time.

rules.name: Low labour efficiency
rules.formula: earned eligible standard labour min / eligible actual labour min x 100 over the window
rules.severity: MEDIUM; HIGH at or below critical
rules.legacy: R01 LOW_PRODUCTIVITY (lines/labour-hour replaced by earned standard minutes; no x resource count)

rules.name: Earned-work gap against plan
rules.formula: eligible actual labour min - earned standard min (shift to date); basis = routing standard at actual crew
rules.legacy: R02 PRODUCTIVITY_GAP (lines gap -> standard-minute gap; completion-bias guard = finished operations only)

rules.name: High comparable backlog / queue growth
rules.formula: standard labour minutes of tanks queued at the work centre vs same-time-of-shift baseline; growth between evaluations
rules.legacy: R04 HIGH_BACKLOG + R05 BACKLOG_GROWTH (open lines -> queued standard minutes; previous = 0 gives NEW_BACKLOG)

rules.name: Qualified labour-capacity imbalance / staffing gap
rules.formula: remaining standard labour (queued + in-process remaining) - unique qualified remaining productive minutes before shift end

rules.name: Excess rework / scrap rate
rules.formula: failed first-attempt inspections / first-attempt inspections at the gate (window); scrap rate = scrapped / tanks inspected
rules.legacy: R08 HIGH_SHORT_RATE / R09 HIGH_CUT_RATE - SHORT/CUT do NOT mean scrap/rework; replaced by gate fail and scrap rates with explicit denominators

rules.name: Productivity-quality conflict (correlation, not blame)
rules.formula: efficiency improves >= 10 pp while gate fail rate rises >= 40% relative between consecutive 120-min windows

rules.name: Workload surge
rules.formula: standard labour (first WC1 labour operation per product, from the routing) of tanks released into WC1 in the last 120 min - batch releases and replacements - vs the same-slot baseline

rules.name: ETC / deadline risk and buffer erosion
rules.formula: GREEN forecast <= cutoff - buffer; AMBER <= cutoff; RED > cutoff or quantity shortfall; UNKNOWN when not estimable
rules.legacy: R12 ETC_COMPLETION_RISK + SMD bands.py cutoff concept (bands.py not supplied; implemented from the prompt definition)

rules.name: Upstream starvation / downstream blocking
rules.formula: qualified crew present and stations free but no released tank available (starved), or finished tanks blocked by a full downstream queue
rules.legacy: (new) WIP exhaustion - waiting is not underperformance

rules.name: Equipment / material interruption
rules.formula: equipment breakdown open, or operation blocked by material shortage

rules.name: Missing qualification / minimum crew
rules.formula: ready work exists but qualified available (incl. valid qualification at sim time) < minimum crew

rules.name: Stale telemetry / assignment delay
rules.formula: stale: no device/app signal > stale_after_min while a task is active (reported as last-known, never idle); assignment delay: ready work + eligible available worker unassigned > delay_min
rules.legacy: S01 OPERATOR_IDLE_WITH_WORK_AVAILABLE (only when ready work AND an eligible available worker exist)

rules.name: Stalled Active Assignment
rules.formula: genuinely started task (WORKING) with fresh activity evidence but no milestone/progress beyond expected interval x factor; excludes cure, breaks, authorised pauses, external holds

rules.name: Regional Workload Imbalance
rules.formula: remaining standard labour by area and skill / uniquely counted qualified remaining capacity; fire when one area ratio > 1.3 while another < 0.7 with transferable qualified people

rules.name: Material Velocity Anomaly
rules.formula: plant-wide NET material issues (issues minus reversals of mistaken issues) per productive labour hour in the session part of the last 120 min vs the same ratio over the baseline days of history known at the fork; zero demand (under 1 productive hour) is not a fault

rules.name: Location Velocity Anomaly
rules.formula: tank dwell at a workstation/buffer vs time-of-shift baseline; distinguishes no supply (empty) from slow processing (occupied, slow)

rules.name: Congestion
rules.formula: finite queue occupancy vs configured physical capacity (WORK_CENTER_MASTER.QUEUE_CAPACITY_UNITS) with persistence, plus blocked arrivals; without capacity no congestion is claimed
rules.severity: MEDIUM; HIGH at 100% with blocked arrivals

rules.name: Replenishment Delay
rules.formula: request outstanding quantity past NEED_BY_AT (partial deliveries reduce outstanding; cancelled requests excluded); linked to material-related waiting
rules.severity: MEDIUM; HIGH if an operation is waiting

cutoff.deadline_basis: ROUTE_COMPLETE (tank route complete; not shipment ready)
